name: 90255 · Huntington Pk, CA
findings: ZIP 90255 (Huntington Pk) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90255 (Huntington Pk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90255 (Huntington Pk) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
